calibration_note: Raster pixel areas were over-counted by ~11-13% (nominal 900 m2/pixel vs true geographic pixel area at ~23.8N). Calibrated columns rescale area-based metrics to the authoritative GEE-computed JRC series (water_area_by_year.csv). Dimensionless metrics (LPI, FI, FRAC, SHDI) and percent changes are unaffected. ENN is distance-based and not rescaled. PD is NP per 304.231 km2 boundary area and is therefore unchanged by the water pixel-area calibration; the V2 version of this column wrongly divided NP by calibrated water area (changing the metric definition) and has been corrected in V3.
